The most effective signal is the **exception event** — a compact, structured diagnostic moment that consistently outperforms all other trace representations across models (Qwen 99.83% ± 0.00 across 3 seeds; DeepSeek 91-99% depending on seed, but always > VOTA 84.45% and no_trace 73.36%). In contrast, richer trace representations that require deeper execution reasoning show model-dependent effectiveness: VOTA gap = 14.96pp, no_trace gap = 1.77pp. Information density — not training signal distribution — is the primary bottleneck: even oracle loss masking (label-only) cannot close the 13pp gap between full traces and targeted extraction. The design principle: **extract the highest-specificity diagnostic signal; discard everything else.** Cross-model absolute performance depends on LoRA initialization stability, but exception_only's relative dominance over other components is robust.\\n\\nVOTA's primary contribution is **fault indicator isolation** — automatically extracting exception events from noisy full traces — rather than generic trace compression. The \\\"compression helps\\\" narrative was a stepping stone; the real mechanism is diagnostic signal extraction.\\n\\n## Core Claims (3)\\n\\n### Claim 1: Exception events are the most effective trace component for verdict prediction\\n\\nException summaries consistently achieve the highest verdict prediction accuracy across both models tested, outperforming all other trace representations in every seed. On Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B, performance is perfectly robust: 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds). On DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, absolute accuracy is seed-dependent (seed42=99.83% epoch1, seed123=91.43% epoch1; Δ=8.40pp), consistent with LoRA initialization sensitivity — but exception_only still dominates VOTA (84.45%) and no_trace (73.36%) in all seeds. This contrasts with VOTA (cross-model gap = 14.96pp) and no_trace (gap = 1.77pp). Exception events are structurally simple (`[ERROR] type: ... message: ...`) and do not require deep trace reasoning.\\n\\n**Supporting evidence:**\\n- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: Qwen 99.83%, ECE=0.0027\\n- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: DeepSeek 99.83% (epoch1) / 99.33% (epoch3)\\n- `deepseek_exception_only_seed456`: DeepSeek 99.33% (epoch3), CI [98.82, 99.75] — 与 seed42 完全一致\\n- `deepseek_exception_only_seed123`: DeepSeek 91.43% (epoch1) / 91.09% (epoch3) — LoRA init sensitivity outlier\\n- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: DeepSeek VOTA 84.45% (gap = 14.96pp vs Qwen)\\n- `deepseek_no_trace_seed42`: DeepSeek no_trace 73.36% (gap = 1.77pp vs Qwen)\\n- `vota_no_ae_seed42`: 99.41% — actual/expected removal 不降，非 trivial string comparison\\n\\n**DeepSeek seed analysis** ✅ (FINALIZED, D029):\\n\\n| Seed | Epoch 3 (final) | fail_recall | pass_recall | train_loss | Errors | CI |\\n|------|-----------------|-------------|-------------|------------|--------|-----|\\n| 42   | 99.33%          | 1.0         | 0.9906      | —          | 8/1190 | — |\\n| 456  | 99.33%          | 1.0         | 0.9906      | 0.1225     | 8/1190 | [98.82, 99.75] |\\n| 123  | 91.09%          | 0.705       | 0.993       | 0.122      | —      | [89.4, 92.6] |\\n\\nseed42 与 seed456 结果**完全一致**（均 8/1190 错误，99.33%），seed123 为离群值。seed123 的 fail_recall 仅 0.705 — LoRA 初始化落入差的局部最优，未充分学到 exception→fail 映射。**关键发现**: seed456 和 seed123 的 train_loss 几乎相同（0.1225 vs 0.122），但 accuracy 差 8.2pp — token-level loss 掩盖了 sample-level 分类能力的巨大差异（详见 D10）。\\n\\n**Irreducible error analysis** ✅: 3 seeds 错误的 2 个样本 (id=901, 905) 均来自 HumanEval/95 (`check_dict_case`)，根因为 Python `all()` 对 generator expression 短路触发 `GeneratorExit`（`BaseException` 子类，非真正错误）。tracer 将其标记为 `[ERROR]`，exception_only 模型看到 7 行 `[ERROR] GeneratorExit`，合理但错误地预测 fail。整个 1190 条测试集仅这 2 条含 `GeneratorExit`，模型无训练信号学习其良性本质。**这确认 99.83% 是 exception_only 表征的理论上限，剩余 0.17% 是 representation-inherent irreducible error，而非模型不足。**\\n\\n**Seed robustness** ✅: Qwen exception_only 3-seed 完全一致，构成本文最强 robustness 证据：\\n\\n| Seed | Accuracy | 95% CI | Errors |\\n|------|----------|--------|--------|\\n| 42 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |\\n| 123 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |\\n| 456 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |\\n\\n3 seeds 错误样本 100% 重叠（id=901, 905, 均为 `check_dict_case` 函数, label=pass → pred=fail）。**Irreducible samples**: 模型已达数据集理论上限，variance = 0。\\n\\n**DeepSeek cross-model** ✅ (D029): 3-seed 完整数据 — seed42/456=99.33%, seed123=91.09%。2/3 seeds 鲁棒，seed123 为 LoRA 初始化离群值（fail_recall 仅 0.705）。Qwen 3-seed 完美稳定 (99.83% ± 0.00) vs DeepSeek 高方差（σ≈4.8pp），暗示 exception signal 的 learnability 与模型 LoRA 训练稳定性相关。但即使最差 seed (91.09%) 仍优于 VOTA (84.45%) 和 no_trace (73.36%)，relative dominance robust。\\n\\n### Claim 2: Information density, not gradient dilution, drives trace compression benefit\\n\\nFull traces help verdict prediction (81.76% [`full_trace_seed42_v5`], +6.6pp over baseline), but VOTA achieves 99.41% [`vota_seed42_v5`] (+24.3pp) — a +17.6pp advantage. Label-only loss ablation (plan_002) quantifies the causal decomposition: **gradient dilution contributes ~26% of the gap** (4.5pp; label-only full_trace = 86.22% [`full_trace_label_only_seed42`]), **information overload contributes ~74%** (13.0pp; only trace compression resolves this). Even with oracle loss masking that eliminates gradient dilution, full traces still underperform VOTA by 13pp.\\n\\nCross-model evidence reinforces this: VOTA gap (14.96pp) partly tracks base model execution reasoning capability (Qwen CRUXEval-I 56.5% vs DeepSeek 39.0%, Δ=17.5pp), though **confounded by DeepSeek training-time trace truncation** (91.7% of VOTA samples truncated to ~2048 tokens; see D11). The two factors cannot be disentangled in the current design. Exception signal partially bypasses both bottlenecks (token-short, no truncation; consistently best component on both models), though DeepSeek shows seed-dependent absolute performance (91-99%).\\n\\n**Supporting evidence:**\\n- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.22%, ECE=0.1107 (gradient dilution fix, +4.5pp over standard full_trace)\\n- `full_trace_seed42_v5`: 81.76%, ECE=0.0958 (standard full_trace)\\n- `vota_seed42_v5`: 99.41%, ECE=0.0054\\n- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (VOTA model-dependent)\\n- CRUXEval literature data (Wang et al.)\\n\\n### Claim 3: Two-tier diagnostic hierarchy for verdict prediction\\n\\nComponent ablation reveals verdict-relevant trace information has a strict two-tier hierarchy:\\n- **Tier 1 — diagnostic moment signals**: exception summaries (99.83% [`vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`]) and assertion-point information (99.92% [`vota_ae_only_seed42`]) are individually near-perfect and sufficient for verdict prediction on Qwen. These signals are structurally simple and consistently the most effective component on both models, though DeepSeek absolute performance is seed-dependent.\\n- **Tier 2 — behavioral patterns**: loop compression (85.63% [`vota_loop_only_seed42`]) carries substantial signal but is model-dependent and fully subsumed by Tier 1.\\n\\nCombining tiers introduces noise rather than helping: exception_only (99.83%) > VOTA full (99.41%), p=0.01. Loop_only ≈ full_trace_label_only (85.63% vs 86.22%) confirms VOTA's loop compression precisely extracts the useful behavioral signal from full traces.\\n\\n**Supporting evidence:**\\n- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: 99.83%, ECE=0.0027 (Tier 1 exception)\\n- `vota_ae_only_seed42`: 99.92%, ECE=0.0004 (Tier 1 assertion-point, 与 exception 统计等价 p=0.80)\\n- `vota_loop_only_seed42`: 85.63%, ECE=0.0831 (Tier 2 behavioral)\\n- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.22%, ECE=0.1107 (≈ loop_only, confirming extraction equivalence)\\n- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: 99.83% epoch1 / 99.33% epoch3 (Tier 1 cross-model validation)\\n- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (Tier 1+2 cross-model: Tier 2 introduces model-dependent degradation)\\n\\n**Calibration**: 完整 calibration 数据确认 Tier 1 信号不仅 accuracy 近完美，置信度校准也近完美：\\n\\n| Condition | Accuracy | ECE | Brier | 解读 |\\n|-----------|----------|-----|-------|------|\\n| ae_only | 99.92% | 0.0004 | 0.0008 | 近乎完美校准 |\\n| exception_only | 99.83% | 0.0027 | 0.0013 | 近乎完美校准 |\\n| VOTA | 99.41% | 0.0054 | 0.005 | 优秀，但 Tier 2 引入轻微 noise |\\n| loop_only | 85.63% | 0.0831 | — | Tier 2 单独校准中等 |\\n| label_only | 86.22% | 0.1107 | — | gradient dilution fix 仍 miscalibrated |\\n| full_trace | 81.76% | 0.0958 | — | 中度 miscalibrated |\\n| no_trace | 75.13% | 0.1715 | 0.1972 | 严重 miscalibrated |\\n\\nno_trace ECE 是 exception_only 的 **~63x**（0.1715/0.0027），Brier 是 **~150x**（0.1972/0.0013）。Trace signal（尤其 Tier 1）不仅提升 accuracy，更从根本上改善模型 calibration。\\n\\n**Design principle**: verdict-optimized traces should extract highest-specificity diagnostic signals; lower-specificity signals are redundant and may introduce noise.\\n\\n## Cross-Model Evidence Summary\\n\\n| Condition | Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B | DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B | Cross-model gap | Interpretation |\\n|-----------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|----------------|\\n| exception_only | 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds) | seed42/456: 99.33%; seed123: 91.09% | 0.50-8.74pp (seed-dependent) | **Best component on both models**; 2/3 DeepSeek seeds match Qwen-level; 1 outlier still > VOTA |\\n| VOTA | 99.41% | 84.45% | -14.96pp | Model-dependent — requires execution reasoning; **also confounded by DeepSeek training-time trace truncation** (91.7% of VOTA samples truncated from mean 2626 to ~2048 tokens; labels preserved via to_chat_text(), see D11) |\\n| no_trace | 75.13% | 73.36% | -1.77pp | Baseline gap tracks general capability |\\n| full_trace | 81.76% | collapsed (v3 pending) | N/A | DeepSeek v1 label truncation bug |\\n\\n**Key insight**: Exception_only is consistently the best component on both models (even worst DeepSeek seed 91.09% > VOTA 84.45%). Cross-model gap 与 signal complexity 正相关, but exception signal's absolute effectiveness also depends on LoRA training stability. Qwen: perfectly robust (3 seeds identical). DeepSeek: 2/3 seeds at 99.33% (matching Qwen-level), 1 outlier at 91.09% (LoRA initialization). Median performance robust; seed sensitivity suggests smaller/weaker models may need training stabilization (multi-seed selection, warmup tuning) for optimal exception signal utilization.\\n\\n## VOTA Repositioning\\n\\n**旧叙事**: VOTA 是 trace compression 方法，价值在于\\\"压缩使 trace 更有效\\\"。\\n\\n**新叙事**: VOTA 是 **fault indicator isolation** 方法，核心价值在于自动从 noisy execution traces 中提取 exception events 等 diagnostic signals。\\n\\n**证据链**:\\n1. exception_only (99.83%) ≥ VOTA full (99.41%) — 压缩后的其他组件（loop, ae）不仅无益，反而引入 noise\\n2. VOTA 跨模型 gap = 14.96pp — 因为 VOTA 包含 model-dependent 的 Tier 2 组件（loop compression 需要 execution reasoning）\\n3. exception_only 在两个模型上均为最优组件 — isolate 出 Tier 1 后，相对优势 robust（虽然 DeepSeek 绝对值 seed-dependent）\\n4. vota_no_ae (99.41%) = VOTA (99.41%) — actual/expected 移除无影响，exception 是真正的 active ingredient\\n\\n**论文中的表述**: \\\"VOTA's trace compression pipeline incidentally isolates exception events — the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal. Its value lies not in making traces shorter, but in separating high-specificity fault indicators from low-specificity behavioral patterns.\\\"\\n\\n**对 Method section 的影响**: VOTA 仍然完整描述（loop compression + exception + actual/expected），但 Results/Discussion 明确指出 exception isolation 是核心机制，其他组件是 model-capability-dependent bonus。\\n\\n## Story Spine\\n\\n- **Problem**: Existing trace SFT studies (DCSH, TracePile) evaluate only generative tasks and find limited, model-dependent benefit. No prior work has tested trace SFT on verdict tasks (binary pass/fail), nor identified what trace components drive classification performance.\\n\\n- **Existing approaches & gaps**: DCSH (EMNLP Findings 2025) tested 5 trace formats on generation tasks, finding that \\\"no single trace representation consistently outperforms others.\\\" TracePile (NeurIPS 2025) scaled to 2.6M samples but only evaluated generation. TRACED (ICSE 2024) showed traces help encoder-based classification. All existing trace formats are designed for execution simulation, not fault detection.\\n\\n- **Our framing**: We reframe verdict prediction as **fault detection** and ask: what is the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal? Through systematic component ablation across two architecturally distinct models, we discover that exception events — compact, structured error summaries — are consistently the most effective trace component, achieving near-perfect accuracy on Qwen (99.83% ± 0.00, 3 seeds) and outperforming all alternatives on DeepSeek (91-99% vs VOTA 84.45%). Richer trace representations work only when the base model has sufficient execution reasoning capability, making them unreliable for general deployment.\\n\\n- **Headline result**: \\\"Exception events consistently achieve the highest verdict accuracy across models (Qwen 99.83%, DeepSeek 91-99%), outperforming VOTA traces (84.45% on DeepSeek, -14.96pp gap) — demonstrating that fault indicator isolation, not trace reasoning, is the robust mechanism for verdict prediction. DeepSeek seed sensitivity reveals LoRA training stability as a secondary factor for smaller models.\\\"\\n\\n## Story Arc\\n\\n1. **Setup**: Trace SFT for code tasks — promising but inconsistent in prior work (DCSH, TracePile). Unknown whether traces help verdict tasks and what trace design matters.\\n\\n2. **First result — traces help, compression helps more** (single model): no_trace 75.13% → full_trace 81.76% → VOTA 99.41%. Label-only loss ablation decomposes the gap: 26% gradient dilution, 74% information overload. Compression improves accuracy through higher information density, not just cost savings.\\n\\n3. **Twist — what component actually drives VOTA?** Component ablation reveals exception_only (99.83%) ≥ full VOTA (99.41%). The \\\"trace reasoning\\\" narrative is wrong — verdict prediction is fault detection. Tier 1 (exceptions + assertion-point) subsumes Tier 2 (loops). Actual/expected removal doesn't hurt (99.41%).\\n\\n4. **Cross-model stress test — consistent dominance, not universal perfection**: Exception_only is the best component on both models (even DeepSeek worst seed 91.09% > VOTA 84.45%), but absolute performance is seed-dependent on DeepSeek (91-99% vs Qwen's perfectly stable 99.83%). VOTA degrades by 14.96pp. The structurally simplest component is the most robust, but LoRA initialization sensitivity introduces variance on weaker models. Qwen seed robustness (3-seed variance = 0) + calibration (ECE=0.0027) 确认 exception signal 在强模型上的 reliability。DeepSeek seed sensitivity 揭示 training stability 作为 secondary bottleneck。\\n\\n5. **Design principle**: For verdict tasks, identify the highest-specificity diagnostic signal (exception events) and discard everything else. VOTA's value is fault indicator isolation — automatically extracting exceptions from noisy traces — not generic compression. Simpler signals are more robust; complexity tolerance depends on model capability.\\n\\n## Dataset Characteristics\\n\\n### Data duplication analysis\\n\\n| Condition | Total | Unique | Duplication rate | Cause |\\n|-----------|-------|--------|------------------|-------|\\n| exception_only_train | 4720 | 2858 | 39.45% | 同题多个 passing 解映射为相同 (input, output) — 无异常 → 同一 trace |\\n| exception_only_test | 1190 | 607 | 48.99% | 同上 |\\n| raw_traces | 5910 | 5803 | 1.81% | 完整 trace 含行号/变量值/内存地址，几乎不重复 |\\n\\n**Train-test input overlap: 0（无数据泄漏）**\\n\\n**解读**: exception_only 高重复率是 representation 的自然属性，非数据问题。多个正确解对同一测试用例执行时若均无异常，exception_only 表征退化为相同的空/无异常标记。这恰好说明 exception signal 的 compactness — 它仅编码 fault presence，不编码 solution identity。raw_traces 重复率极低 (1.81%) 因为完整 trace 包含 solution-specific 信息（变量值、内存地址）。尽管高重复率意味着有效训练样本少于名义数量，模型仍达 99.83% — 进一步确认 exception signal 的 learnability。\\n\\n## DeepSeek full_trace 处理\\n\\n**现状**: v1 坍塌（28.5%, 100% 预测 fail, 根因: 训练端 label 截断）。v2 重训启动但被 kill（Loop #6 ops worker 腾 GPU 给 vota_seed456）。v3 RUNNING（label-preserving truncation fix）。\\n\\n**处理方案**: v3 正在 cuda:0 上训练，预计 5/16 完成。\\n\\n**VOTA vs full_trace 截断机制区分** (D030 token analysis 确认):\\n- **full_trace v1**: SFTTrainer right-truncation 切掉了 verdict **label** → 100% predict fail → 坍塌。根因: DeepSeek tokenizer 对 full_trace 产生 >2048 tokens, label 在截断窗口外。\\n- **VOTA**: `to_chat_text()` 保留 verdict label（label 完整），但 91.7% 的样本 **trace content（input）被截断**（mean 2626 → ~2048 tokens）。84.45% 是真实结果，反映 trace 信息损失对模型学习的影响，**不是** label corruption。\\n- **exception_only**: token 长度远低于 2048，不受截断影响，跨模型对比 clean。\\n\\n**对论文叙事的影响**: 论文中所有 \\\"right-truncation corrupts/removes the verdict label\\\" 措辞**对 VOTA 不成立**——label 完整保留，被截断的是 trace input。正确表述: \\\"trace content truncation causes information loss\\\"。VOTA cross-model gap (14.96pp) 有两个贡献因素: (1) model capability, (2) training-time trace truncation on DeepSeek (see D11)。\\n\\n## External Benchmark (DebugBench) Positioning\\n\\n**DebugBench 仅作泛化性验证，不作 trace importance 证据。**\\n\\n| Condition | Main Dataset | DebugBench | Δ interpretation |\\n|-----------|-------------|------------|------------------|\\n| no_trace | 75.13% | 96.71% | DebugBench 天花板高，baseline 已强 |\\n| VOTA | 99.41% | 99.77% | +3.06pp lift — 边际 |\\n| exception_only | 99.83% | 100.00% | +3.29pp lift — 边际 |\\n\\n**主数据集 trace lift = 24.70pp**（no_trace → exception_only），DebugBench trace lift 不到其 1/7。\\n\\n**论文定位规则**：\\n- DebugBench → 泛化性证据（exception_only 100% = 跨数据集鲁棒性）\\n- Trace importance 论证 → 仅依赖主数据集（24.7pp lift）\\n- 禁止用 DebugBench 的 3.29pp lift 论证 \\\"trace 的核心价值\\\"——审稿人会攻击天花板效应\\n\\n## Venue Fit Risks\\n\\n| Risk | Assessment | Mitigation |\\n|------|-----------|------------|\\n| 单任务 | 仍然只在 test verdict prediction 上验证 | 跨模型验证部分弥补; Discussion 中讨论 generalization |\\n| 单数据集 | HumanEval + MBPP-sanitized 是唯一数据源 (591 problems × 10 solutions) | 定位为 empirical study, 深度优于广度; 两个标准 benchmark 组合覆盖多样编程题型; exception_only 有效训练样本仅 2858 unique 即达 99.83%, 暗示 signal 的 simplicity 降低对数据量的依赖 |\\n| \\\"只是 feature engineering\\\" | exception extraction 不复杂 | simplicity 本身是 contribution — 最简信号最 robust |\\n| Negative result 味道 | VOTA 跨模型不 robust | Reframe: 识别 robust vs non-robust 组件边界是 positive |\\n| Seed robustness (Qwen) | ✅ 已解决: 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds), irreducible samples 确认 | — |\\n| Seed robustness (DeepSeek) | ✅ 3-seed 完整: 2/3 at 99.33%, 1 at 91.09% | LoRA initialization sensitivity — median robust, worst still > all alternatives; 转化为 training stability finding (D9/D10) |\\n| Calibration | ✅ 完整数据: Tier 1 ECE≤0.003, no_trace ECE=0.171 (~63x gap) | Brier ~150x gap 进一步确认 |\\n| 只用 2 个模型 | 有限但有意义的 diversity | Architecture + pretraining data (5.5T vs 2T) + CRUXEval gap (17.5pp) 构成充分差异 |\\n| 数据重复率 | exception_only 训练集 39.45% 重复 | 非数据泄漏（train-test overlap = 0）；是 representation compactness 的自然结果；有效样本仍足够学习 |\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n| Concern | Planned Response |\\n|---------|-----------------|\\n| \\\"exception_only 99.83% 是不是 trivial pattern matching [ERROR] 有无？\\\" | full_trace 也包含 [ERROR] 但仅 81.76%——模型需要从 trace context 中 extract 和 utilize exception signal, 不是简单 keyword detection. no_trace 无 exception, 75.13%. |\\n| \\\"为什么 exception_only > VOTA? adding info 反而降?\\\" | 非 exception 组件 (loop/ae tokens) 稀释 attention 对 exception 信号的聚焦. Calibration: exception_only ECE=0.0027 vs VOTA ECE=0.0054. 部分样本 loop 正常但有 exception, 引入矛盾信号. |\\n| \\\"CRUXEval gap 与 VOTA gap 的相关性可能是 coincidence\\\" | 明确标注为 hypothesis. 列出 alternatives (tokenizer efficiency, pretraining scale 2.75x, chat template). 不 overclaim. |\\n| \\\"只有 2 个模型，universality claim 太强\\\" | 同意是 limitation. 两模型在 architecture (RoPE vs ALiBi), pretraining data (5.5T vs 2T), execution reasoning (CRUXEval 17.5pp gap) 上有充分差异, 不是 trivial replication. Exception signal partially bypasses both bottlenecks (token-short, no truncation; consistently best component on both models), though DeepSeek shows seed-dependent absolute performance (91-99%).\\n\\n**Supporting evidence:**\\n- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.22%, ECE=0.1107 (gradient dilution fix, +4.5pp over standard full_trace)\\n- `full_trace_seed42_v5`: 81.76%, ECE=0.0958 (standard full_trace)\\n- `vota_seed42_v5`: 99.41%, ECE=0.0054\\n- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (VOTA model-dependent)\\n- CRUXEval literature data (Wang et al.)\\n\\n### Claim 3: Two-tier diagnostic hierarchy for verdict prediction\\n\\nComponent ablation reveals verdict-relevant trace information has a strict two-tier hierarchy:\\n- **Tier 1 — diagnostic moment signals**: exception summaries (99.83% [`vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`]) and assertion-point information (99.92% [`vota_ae_only_seed42`]) are individually near-perfect and sufficient for verdict prediction on Qwen. These signals are structurally simple and consistently the most effective component on both models, though DeepSeek absolute performance is seed-dependent.\\n- **Tier 2 — behavioral patterns**: loop compression (85.63% [`vota_loop_only_seed42`]) carries substantial signal but is model-dependent and fully subsumed by Tier 1.\\n\\nCombining tiers introduces noise rather than helping: exception_only (99.83%) > VOTA full (99.41%), p=0.01. Loop_only ≈ full_trace_label_only (85.63% vs 86.22%) confirms VOTA's loop compression precisely extracts the useful behavioral signal from full traces.\\n\\n**Supporting evidence:**\\n- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: 99.83%, ECE=0.0027 (Tier 1 exception)\\n- `vota_ae_only_seed42`: 99.92%, ECE=0.0004 (Tier 1 assertion-point, 与 exception 统计等价 p=0.80)\\n- `vota_loop_only_seed42`: 85.63%, ECE=0.0831 (Tier 2 behavioral)\\n- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.22%, ECE=0.1107 (≈ loop_only, confirming extraction equivalence)\\n- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: 99.83% epoch1 / 99.33% epoch3 (Tier 1 cross-model validation)\\n- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (Tier 1+2 cross-model: Tier 2 introduces model-dependent degradation)\\n\\n**Calibration**: 完整 calibration 数据确认 Tier 1 信号不仅 accuracy 近完美，置信度校准也近完美：\\n\\n| Condition | Accuracy | ECE | Brier | 解读 |\\n|-----------|----------|-----|-------|------|\\n| ae_only | 99.92% | 0.0004 | 0.0008 | 近乎完美校准 |\\n| exception_only | 99.83% | 0.0027 | 0.0013 | 近乎完美校准 |\\n| VOTA | 99.41% | 0.0054 | 0.005 | 优秀，但 Tier 2 引入轻微 noise |\\n| loop_only | 85.63% | 0.0831 | — | Tier 2 单独校准中等 |\\n| label_only | 86.22% | 0.1107 | — | gradient dilution fix 仍 miscalibrated |\\n| full_trace | 81.76% | 0.0958 | — | 中度 miscalibrated |\\n| no_trace | 75.13% | 0.1715 | 0.1972 | 严重 miscalibrated |\\n\\nno_trace ECE 是 exception_only 的 **~63x**（0.1715/0.0027），Brier 是 **~150x**（0.1972/0.0013）。Trace signal（尤其 Tier 1）不仅提升 accuracy，更从根本上改善模型 calibration。\\n\\n**Design principle**: verdict-optimized traces should extract highest-specificity diagnostic signals; lower-specificity signals are redundant and may introduce noise.\\n\\n## Cross-Model Evidence Summary\\n\\n| Condition | Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B | DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B | Cross-model gap | Interpretation |\\n|-----------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|----------------|\\n| exception_only | 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds) | seed42/456: 99.33%; Median performance robust; seed sensitivity suggests smaller/weaker models may need training stabilization (multi-seed selection, warmup tuning) for optimal exception signal utilization.\\n\\n## VOTA Repositioning\\n\\n**旧叙事**: VOTA 是 trace compression 方法，价值在于\\\"压缩使 trace 更有效\\\"。\\n\\n**新叙事**: VOTA 是 **fault indicator isolation** 方法，核心价值在于自动从 noisy execution traces 中提取 exception events 等 diagnostic signals。\\n\\n**证据链**:\\n1. exception_only (99.83%) ≥ VOTA full (99.41%) — 压缩后的其他组件（loop, ae）不仅无益，反而引入 noise\\n2. VOTA 跨模型 gap = 14.96pp — 因为 VOTA 包含 model-dependent 的 Tier 2 组件（loop compression 需要 execution reasoning）\\n3. exception_only 在两个模型上均为最优组件 — isolate 出 Tier 1 后，相对优势 robust（虽然 DeepSeek 绝对值 seed-dependent）\\n4. vota_no_ae (99.41%) = VOTA (99.41%) — actual/expected 移除无影响，exception 是真正的 active ingredient\\n\\n**论文中的表述**: \\\"VOTA's trace compression pipeline incidentally isolates exception events — the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal. Its value lies not in making traces shorter, but in separating high-specificity fault indicators from low-specificity behavioral patterns.\\\"\\n\\n**对 Method section 的影响**: VOTA 仍然完整描述（loop compression + exception + actual/expected），但 Results/Discussion 明确指出 exception isolation 是核心机制，其他组件是 model-capability-dependent bonus。\\n\\n## Story Spine\\n\\n- **Problem**: Existing trace SFT studies (DCSH, TracePile) evaluate only generative tasks and find limited, model-dependent benefit. No prior work has tested trace SFT on verdict tasks (binary pass/fail), nor identified what trace components drive classification performance.\\n\\n- **Existing approaches & gaps**: DCSH (EMNLP Findings 2025) tested 5 trace formats on generation tasks, finding that \\\"no single trace representation consistently outperforms others.\\\" TracePile (NeurIPS 2025) scaled to 2.6M samples but only evaluated generation. TRACED (ICSE 2024) showed traces help encoder-based classification. All existing trace formats are designed for execution simulation, not fault detection.\\n\\n- **Our framing**: We reframe verdict prediction as **fault detection** and ask: what is the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal? Through systematic component ablation across two architecturally distinct models, we discover that exception events — compact, structured error summaries — are consistently the most effective trace component, achieving near-perfect accuracy on Qwen (99.83% ± 0.00, 3 seeds) and outperforming all alternatives on DeepSeek (91-99% vs VOTA 84.45%). Richer trace representations work only when the base model has sufficient execution reasoning capability, making them unreliable for general deployment.\\n\\n- **Headline result**: \\\"Exception events consistently achieve the highest verdict accuracy across models (Qwen 99.83%, DeepSeek 91-99%), outperforming VOTA traces (84.45% on DeepSeek, -14.96pp gap) — demonstrating that fault indicator isolation, not trace reasoning, is the robust mechanism for verdict prediction. DeepSeek seed sensitivity reveals LoRA training stability as a secondary factor for smaller models.\\\"\\n\\n## Story Arc\\n\\n1. **Setup**: Trace SFT for code tasks — promising but inconsistent in prior work (DCSH, TracePile). Unknown whether traces help verdict tasks and what trace design matters.\\n\\n2. **First result — traces help, compression helps more** (single model): no_trace 75.13% → full_trace 81.76% → VOTA 99.41%. Label-only loss ablation decomposes the gap: 26% gradient dilution, 74% information overload. Compression improves accuracy through higher information density, not just cost savings.\\n\\n3. **Twist — what component actually drives VOTA?** Component ablation reveals exception_only (99.83%) ≥ full VOTA (99.41%). The \\\"trace reasoning\\\" narrative is wrong — verdict prediction is fault detection. Tier 1 (exceptions + assertion-point) subsumes Tier 2 (loops). Actual/expected removal doesn't hurt (99.41%).\\n\\n4. **Cross-model stress test — consistent dominance, not universal perfection**: Exception_only is the best component on both models (even DeepSeek worst seed 91.09% > VOTA 84.45%), but absolute performance is seed-dependent on DeepSeek (91-99% vs Qwen's perfectly stable 99.83%). VOTA degrades by 14.96pp. The structurally simplest component is the most robust, but LoRA initialization sensitivity introduces variance on weaker models. Qwen seed robustness (3-seed variance = 0) + calibration (ECE=0.0027) 确认 exception signal 在强模型上的 reliability。DeepSeek seed sensitivity 揭示 training stability 作为 secondary bottleneck。\\n\\n5. **Design principle**: For verdict tasks, identify the highest-specificity diagnostic signal (exception events) and discard everything else. VOTA's value is fault indicator isolation — automatically extracting exceptions from noisy traces — not generic compression. Simpler signals are more robust; complexity tolerance depends on model capability.\\n\\n## Dataset Characteristics\\n\\n### Data duplication analysis\\n\\n| Condition | Total | Unique | Duplication **标注**: hypothesis, N=2, 列出 alternatives. 不 overclaim. **注意**: 我们的训练/测试数据来自 HumanEval + MBPP-sanitized（非 CRUXEval），CRUXEval-I 分数仅作为衡量两个模型 execution reasoning 能力差异的外部参照。论文中必须明确区分数据来源与外部基准引用。**D030/D034 truncation evidence**: 14.96pp gap 中截断效应有因果证据: group_analysis 显示 train-truncated 83.04% vs train-intact 100% (Fisher p≈0, 推理时无截断)。截断因果方向可 claim，模型能力差异是 residual confound。CRUXEval gap 数值吻合可能部分巧合。论文中截断效应应作为 established factor 讨论（有 group_analysis 因果证据），模型能力假说标注为 residual confound hypothesis。\\n\\n### D3: Simplicity as robustness (revised)\\nException signal 在两模型上均为最优组件，其结构简单性确保了相对优势的跨模型 robustness。但 DeepSeek seed sensitivity 揭示：simplicity 确保 signal 本身 robust，但 LoRA 训练过程是否稳定收敛到正确映射取决于模型。**trace design 应匹配 deployment model 的能力下界**，且需关注 training stability（建议：多 seed 验证 + 考虑 training stabilization 技巧如 warmup、learning rate schedule）。\\n\\n### D4: Checkpoint selection 与 gap 报告 (revised)\\n正文报告所有 seeds 的 final checkpoint 结果 + best checkpoint 结果，不 cherry-pick。DeepSeek seed42: epoch1=99.83%, epoch3=99.33%（退化 0.50pp）。DeepSeek seed123: epoch1=91.43%, epoch3=91.09%（退化 0.34pp）。两个 seed 均显示轻微 epoch 退化，但核心差异在 epoch1 起点（8.40pp gap），不是训练过程。\\n\\n### D5: Irreducible samples — GeneratorExit 根因分析\\n3 seeds 的 2/1190 errors 完全相同（id=901, 905, 均来自 HumanEval/95 `check_dict_case`），方向一致（pass→fail false negatives）。\\n\\n**根因**: Python `all()` 对 generator expression 短路时丢弃未耗尽的 generator，触发 `GeneratorExit`。`GeneratorExit` 继承自 `BaseException`（非 `Exception`），是 Python 内部控制流机制而非真正错误。但 tracer 对所有 caught exceptions 统一标记 `[ERROR]`，导致 exception_only 模型看到 7 行 `[ERROR] GeneratorExit`，合理但错误地预测 fail。\\n\\n**为何不可约**:\\n1. **表征局限**: exception_only 条件下模型仅见异常数据，无法访问控制流、返回值或 assertion 结果。`GeneratorExit` 在此表征中与真正错误不可区分。\\n2. **跨 seed 确定性**: 3 个 random seeds 产生完全相同的 errors，确认这是 data/representation 属性而非模型初始化随机性。\\n3. **训练集无信号**: 整个 1190 条测试集仅这 2 条含 `GeneratorExit`，训练集中也缺乏足够的 `GeneratorExit` 良性样本供模型学习。\\n4. **人类也会犯错**: 仅看 exception trace（7 行 `[ERROR]`），人类审查者在不了解 Python generator protocol 的情况下也会预测 fail。\\n\\n**对论文的意义**: (1) 99.83% 是 exception_only representation 在此数据集上的理论 ceiling，非 saturation artifact；(2) 揭示 tracer 设计的改进方向——区分 `BaseException` 子类（如 `GeneratorExit`, `KeyboardInterrupt`）与 `Exception` 子类（真正的程序错误）可消除此类 irreducible error；(3) 提供 concrete evidence 说明 exception_only 模型\\\"理解\\\"的是 `[ERROR]` tag 的 fault indicator 语义，而非 exception type 的 fine-grained 含义。\\n\\n### D6: Calibration as secondary evidence\\nCalibration 数据提供独立于 accuracy 的 evidence dimension。no_trace Brier=0.1972 说明模型无 trace 时不仅预测错，且对错误预测过度自信。exception_only Brier=0.0013 > v3.0 — [UPDATED 2026-05-15] D030 CLOSED: DeepSeek VOTA 84.45% confirmed correct (confirmatory re-eval). **Critical narrative fix**: to_chat_text() preserves labels → VOTA 训练时 verdict label 未被截断 → 论文中 "label truncation/corruption" 措辞对 VOTA 不成立。正确叙事: trace INPUT content 被截断 (91.7% samples), 84.45% 反映 trace information loss。新增 D11: VOTA cross-model gap confounded by training-time truncation。数据集来源：HumanEval (164) + MBPP-sanitized (427) = 591 problems × 10 LLM-generated solutions = 5910 samples。

## Target Venue
- Primary: EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR submission)
- Fallback: EMNLP 2026 Findings
- Deadline: ARR May 25, 2026

## Core Insight

Verdict prediction (pass/fail) is fundamentally a **fault detection** task. The most effective signal is the **exception event** — a compact, structured diagnostic moment that consistently outperforms all other trace representations across models (Qwen 99.83% ± 0.00 across 3 seeds; DeepSeek 91-99% depending on seed, but always > VOTA 84.45% and no_trace 73.36%). In contrast, richer trace representations that require deeper execution reasoning show model-dependent effectiveness: VOTA gap = 14.96pp, no_trace gap = 1.77pp. Information density — not training signal distribution — is the primary bottleneck: even oracle loss masking (label-only) cannot close the 13pp gap between full traces and targeted extraction. The design principle: **extract the highest-specificity diagnostic signal; discard everything else.** Cross-model absolute performance depends on LoRA initialization stability, but exception_only's relative dominance over other components is robust.

VOTA's primary contribution is **fault indicator isolation** — automatically extracting exception events from noisy full traces — rather than generic trace compression. The "compression helps" narrative was a stepping stone; the real mechanism is diagnostic signal extraction.

## Core Claims (3)

### Claim 1: Exception events are the most effective trace component for verdict prediction

Exception summaries consistently achieve the highest verdict prediction accuracy across both models tested, outperforming all other trace representations in every seed. On Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B, performance is perfectly robust: 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds). On DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, absolute accuracy is seed-dependent (seed42=99.83% epoch1, seed123=91.43% epoch1; Δ=8.40pp), consistent with LoRA initialization sensitivity — but exception_only still dominates VOTA (84.45%) and no_trace (73.36%) in all seeds. This contrasts with VOTA (cross-model gap = 14.96pp) and no_trace (gap = 1.77pp). Exception events are structurally simple (`[ERROR] type: ... message: ...`) and do not require deep trace reasoning.

**Supporting evidence:**
- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: Qwen 99.83%, ECE=0.0027
- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: DeepSeek 99.83% (epoch1) / 99.33% (epoch3)
- `deepseek_exception_only_seed456`: DeepSeek 99.33% (epoch3), CI [98.82, 99.75] — 与 seed42 完全一致
- `deepseek_exception_only_seed123`: DeepSeek 91.43% (epoch1) / 91.09% (epoch3) — LoRA init sensitivity outlier
- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: DeepSeek VOTA 84.45% (gap = 14.96pp vs Qwen)
- `deepseek_no_trace_seed42`: DeepSeek no_trace 73.36% (gap = 1.77pp vs Qwen)
- `vota_no_ae_seed42`: 99.41% — actual/expected removal 不降，非 trivial string comparison

**DeepSeek seed analysis** ✅ (FINALIZED, D029):

| Seed | Epoch 3 (final) | fail_recall | pass_recall | train_loss | Errors | CI |
|------|-----------------|-------------|-------------|------------|--------|-----|
| 42   | 99.33%          | 1.0         | 0.9906      | —          | 8/1190 | — |
| 456  | 99.33%          | 1.0         | 0.9906      | 0.1225     | 8/1190 | [98.82, 99.75] |
| 123  | 91.09%          | 0.705       | 0.993       | 0.122      | —      | [89.4, 92.6] |

seed42 与 seed456 结果**完全一致**（均 8/1190 错误，99.33%），seed123 为离群值。seed123 的 fail_recall 仅 0.705 — LoRA 初始化落入差的局部最优，未充分学到 exception→fail 映射。**关键发现**: seed456 和 seed123 的 train_loss 几乎相同（0.1225 vs 0.122），但 accuracy 差 8.2pp — token-level loss 掩盖了 sample-level 分类能力的巨大差异（详见 D10）。

**Irreducible error analysis** ✅: 3 seeds 错误的 2 个样本 (id=901, 905) 均来自 HumanEval/95 (`check_dict_case`)，根因为 Python `all()` 对 generator expression 短路触发 `GeneratorExit`（`BaseException` 子类，非真正错误）。tracer 将其标记为 `[ERROR]`，exception_only 模型看到 7 行 `[ERROR] GeneratorExit`，合理但错误地预测 fail。整个 1190 条测试集仅这 2 条含 `GeneratorExit`，模型无训练信号学习其良性本质。**这确认 99.83% 是 exception_only 表征的理论上限，剩余 0.17% 是 representation-inherent irreducible error，而非模型不足。**

**Seed robustness** ✅: Qwen exception_only 3-seed 完全一致，构成本文最强 robustness 证据：

| Seed | Accuracy | 95% CI | Errors |
|------|----------|--------|--------|
| 42 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |
| 123 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |
| 456 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |

3 seeds 错误样本 100% 重叠（id=901, 905, 均为 `check_dict_case` 函数, label=pass → pred=fail）。**Irreducible samples**: 模型已达数据集理论上限，variance = 0。

**DeepSeek cross-model** ✅ (D029): 3-seed 完整数据 — seed42/456=99.33%, seed123=91.09%。2/3 seeds 鲁棒，seed123 为 LoRA 初始化离群值（fail_recall 仅 0.705）。Qwen 3-seed 完美稳定 (99.83% ± 0.00) vs DeepSeek 高方差（σ≈4.8pp），暗示 exception signal 的 learnability 与模型 LoRA 训练稳定性相关。但即使最差 seed (91.09%) 仍优于 VOTA (84.45%) 和 no_trace (73.36%)，relative dominance robust。

### Claim 2: Information density, not gradient dilution, drives trace compression benefit

Full traces help verdict prediction (81.76% [`full_trace_seed42_v5`], +6.6pp over baseline), but VOTA achieves 99.41% [`vota_seed42_v5`] (+24.3pp) — a +17.6pp advantage. Label-only loss ablation (plan_002) quantifies the causal decomposition: **gradient dilution contributes ~26% of the gap** (4.5pp; label-only full_trace = 86.22% [`full_trace_label_only_seed42`]), **information overload contributes ~74%** (13.0pp; only trace compression resolves this). Even with oracle loss masking that eliminates gradient dilution, full traces still underperform VOTA by 13pp.

Cross-model evidence reinforces this: VOTA gap (14.96pp) partly tracks base model execution reasoning capability (Qwen CRUXEval-I 56.5% vs DeepSeek 39.0%, Δ=17.5pp), though **confounded by DeepSeek training-time trace truncation** (91.7% of VOTA samples truncated to ~2048 tokens; see D11). The two factors cannot be disentangled in the current design. Exception signal partially bypasses both bottlenecks (token-short, no truncation; consistently best component on both models), though DeepSeek shows seed-dependent absolute performance (91-99%).

**Supporting evidence:**
- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.22%, ECE=0.1107 (gradient dilution fix, +4.5pp over standard full_trace)
- `full_trace_seed42_v5`: 81.76%, ECE=0.0958 (standard full_trace)
- `vota_seed42_v5`: 99.41%, ECE=0.0054
- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (VOTA model-dependent)
- CRUXEval literature data (Wang et al.)

### Claim 3: Two-tier diagnostic hierarchy for verdict prediction

Component ablation reveals verdict-relevant trace information has a strict two-tier hierarchy:
- **Tier 1 — diagnostic moment signals**: exception summaries (99.83% [`vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`]) and assertion-point information (99.92% [`vota_ae_only_seed42`]) are individually near-perfect and sufficient for verdict prediction on Qwen. These signals are structurally simple and consistently the most effective component on both models, though DeepSeek absolute performance is seed-dependent.
- **Tier 2 — behavioral patterns**: loop compression (85.63% [`vota_loop_only_seed42`]) carries substantial signal but is model-dependent and fully subsumed by Tier 1.

Combining tiers introduces noise rather than helping: exception_only (99.83%) > VOTA full (99.41%), p=0.01. Loop_only ≈ full_trace_label_only (85.63% vs 86.22%) confirms VOTA's loop compression precisely extracts the useful behavioral signal from full traces.

**Supporting evidence:**
- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: 99.83%, ECE=0.0027 (Tier 1 exception)
- `vota_ae_only_seed42`: 99.92%, ECE=0.0004 (Tier 1 assertion-point, 与 exception 统计等价 p=0.80)
- `vota_loop_only_seed42`: 85.63%, ECE=0.0831 (Tier 2 behavioral)
- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.22%, ECE=0.1107 (≈ loop_only, confirming extraction equivalence)
- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: 99.83% epoch1 / 99.33% epoch3 (Tier 1 cross-model validation)
- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (Tier 1+2 cross-model: Tier 2 introduces model-dependent degradation)

**Calibration**: 完整 calibration 数据确认 Tier 1 信号不仅 accuracy 近完美，置信度校准也近完美：

| Condition | Accuracy | ECE | Brier | 解读 |
|-----------|----------|-----|-------|------|
| ae_only | 99.92% | 0.0004 | 0.0008 | 近乎完美校准 |
| exception_only | 99.83% | 0.0027 | 0.0013 | 近乎完美校准 |
| VOTA | 99.41% | 0.0054 | 0.005 | 优秀，但 Tier 2 引入轻微 noise |
| loop_only | 85.63% | 0.0831 | — | Tier 2 单独校准中等 |
| label_only | 86.22% | 0.1107 | — | gradient dilution fix 仍 miscalibrated |
| full_trace | 81.76% | 0.0958 | — | 中度 miscalibrated |
| no_trace | 75.13% | 0.1715 | 0.1972 | 严重 miscalibrated |

no_trace ECE 是 exception_only 的 **~63x**（0.1715/0.0027），Brier 是 **~150x**（0.1972/0.0013）。Trace signal（尤其 Tier 1）不仅提升 accuracy，更从根本上改善模型 calibration。

**Design principle**: verdict-optimized traces should extract highest-specificity diagnostic signals; lower-specificity signals are redundant and may introduce noise.

## Cross-Model Evidence Summary

| Condition | Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B | DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B | Cross-model gap | Interpretation |
|-----------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|----------------|
| exception_only | 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds) | seed42/456: 99.33%; seed123: 91.09% | 0.50-8.74pp (seed-dependent) | **Best component on both models**; 2/3 DeepSeek seeds match Qwen-level; 1 outlier still > VOTA |
| VOTA | 99.41% | 84.45% | -14.96pp | Model-dependent — requires execution reasoning; **also confounded by DeepSeek training-time trace truncation** (91.7% of VOTA samples truncated from mean 2626 to ~2048 tokens; labels preserved via to_chat_text(), see D11) |
| no_trace | 75.13% | 73.36% | -1.77pp | Baseline gap tracks general capability |
| full_trace | 81.76% | collapsed (v3 pending) | N/A | DeepSeek v1 label truncation bug |

**Key insight**: Exception_only is consistently the best component on both models (even worst DeepSeek seed 91.09% > VOTA 84.45%). Cross-model gap 与 signal complexity 正相关, but exception signal's absolute effectiveness also depends on LoRA training stability. Qwen: perfectly robust (3 seeds identical). DeepSeek: 2/3 seeds at 99.33% (matching Qwen-level), 1 outlier at 91.09% (LoRA initialization). Median performance robust; seed sensitivity suggests smaller/weaker models may need training stabilization (multi-seed selection, warmup tuning) for optimal exception signal utilization.

## VOTA Repositioning

**旧叙事**: VOTA 是 trace compression 方法，价值在于"压缩使 trace 更有效"。

**新叙事**: VOTA 是 **fault indicator isolation** 方法，核心价值在于自动从 noisy execution traces 中提取 exception events 等 diagnostic signals。

**证据链**:
1. exception_only (99.83%) ≥ VOTA full (99.41%) — 压缩后的其他组件（loop, ae）不仅无益，反而引入 noise
2. VOTA 跨模型 gap = 14.96pp — 因为 VOTA 包含 model-dependent 的 Tier 2 组件（loop compression 需要 execution reasoning）
3. exception_only 在两个模型上均为最优组件 — isolate 出 Tier 1 后，相对优势 robust（虽然 DeepSeek 绝对值 seed-dependent）
4. vota_no_ae (99.41%) = VOTA (99.41%) — actual/expected 移除无影响，exception 是真正的 active ingredient

**论文中的表述**: "VOTA's trace compression pipeline incidentally isolates exception events — the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal. Its value lies not in making traces shorter, but in separating high-specificity fault indicators from low-specificity behavioral patterns."

**对 Method section 的影响**: VOTA 仍然完整描述（loop compression + exception + actual/expected），但 Results/Discussion 明确指出 exception isolation 是核心机制，其他组件是 model-capability-dependent bonus。

## Story Spine

- **Problem**: Existing trace SFT studies (DCSH, TracePile) evaluate only generative tasks and find limited, model-dependent benefit. No prior work has tested trace SFT on verdict tasks (binary pass/fail), nor identified what trace components drive classification performance.

- **Existing approaches & gaps**: DCSH (EMNLP Findings 2025) tested 5 trace formats on generation tasks, finding that "no single trace representation consistently outperforms others." TracePile (NeurIPS 2025) scaled to 2.6M samples but only evaluated generation. TRACED (ICSE 2024) showed traces help encoder-based classification. All existing trace formats are designed for execution simulation, not fault detection.

- **Our framing**: We reframe verdict prediction as **fault detection** and ask: what is the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal? Through systematic component ablation across two architecturally distinct models, we discover that exception events — compact, structured error summaries — are consistently the most effective trace component, achieving near-perfect accuracy on Qwen (99.83% ± 0.00, 3 seeds) and outperforming all alternatives on DeepSeek (91-99% vs VOTA 84.45%). Richer trace representations work only when the base model has sufficient execution reasoning capability, making them unreliable for general deployment.

- **Headline result**: "Exception events consistently achieve the highest verdict accuracy across models (Qwen 99.83%, DeepSeek 91-99%), outperforming VOTA traces (84.45% on DeepSeek, -14.96pp gap) — demonstrating that fault indicator isolation, not trace reasoning, is the robust mechanism for verdict prediction. DeepSeek seed sensitivity reveals LoRA training stability as a secondary factor for smaller models."

## Story Arc

1. **Setup**: Trace SFT for code tasks — promising but inconsistent in prior work (DCSH, TracePile). Unknown whether traces help verdict tasks and what trace design matters.

2. **First result — traces help, compression helps more** (single model): no_trace 75.13% → full_trace 81.76% → VOTA 99.41%. Label-only loss ablation decomposes the gap: 26% gradient dilution, 74% information overload. Compression improves accuracy through higher information density, not just cost savings.

3. **Twist — what component actually drives VOTA?** Component ablation reveals exception_only (99.83%) ≥ full VOTA (99.41%). The "trace reasoning" narrative is wrong — verdict prediction is fault detection. Tier 1 (exceptions + assertion-point) subsumes Tier 2 (loops). Actual/expected removal doesn't hurt (99.41%).

4. **Cross-model stress test — consistent dominance, not universal perfection**: Exception_only is the best component on both models (even DeepSeek worst seed 91.09% > VOTA 84.45%), but absolute performance is seed-dependent on DeepSeek (91-99% vs Qwen's perfectly stable 99.83%). VOTA degrades by 14.96pp. The structurally simplest component is the most robust, but LoRA initialization sensitivity introduces variance on weaker models. Qwen seed robustness (3-seed variance = 0) + calibration (ECE=0.0027) 确认 exception signal 在强模型上的 reliability。DeepSeek seed sensitivity 揭示 training stability 作为 secondary bottleneck。

5. **Design principle**: For verdict tasks, identify the highest-specificity diagnostic signal (exception events) and discard everything else. VOTA's value is fault indicator isolation — automatically extracting exceptions from noisy traces — not generic compression. Simpler signals are more robust; complexity tolerance depends on model capability.

## Dataset Characteristics

### Data duplication analysis

| Condition | Total | Unique | Duplication rate | Cause |
|-----------|-------|--------|------------------|-------|
| exception_only_train | 4720 | 2858 | 39.45% | 同题多个 passing 解映射为相同 (input, output) — 无异常 → 同一 trace |
| exception_only_test | 1190 | 607 | 48.99% | 同上 |

**Train-test input overlap: 0（无数据泄漏）**

- **full_trace v1**: SFTTrainer right-truncation 切掉了 verdict **label** → 100% predict fail → 坍塌。根因: DeepSeek tokenizer 对 full_trace 产生 >2048 tokens, label 在截断窗口外。

## Discussion 要点

### D1: eval_loss vs verdict accuracy 解耦
DeepSeek VOTA: eval_loss epoch1→3 从 0.068 升至 0.112 (+65%), 但 accuracy 从 78.15% 升至 84.45% (+6.3pp). Token-level calibration 与 binary classification accuracy 方向相反. **Implication**: verdict tasks 应用 task-specific metric (accuracy/F1) 做 checkpoint selection, 非 eval_loss.

### D2: CRUXEval gap 假说 (revised — D030 confound)
VOTA 跨模型 gap (14.96pp) 与 CRUXEval execution reasoning gap (15-17.5pp) 数值吻合. 假说: trace utilization effectiveness 受 base model "execution reasoning readiness" 约束. **标注**: hypothesis, N=2, 列出 alternatives. 不 overclaim. **注意**: 我们的训练/测试数据来自 HumanEval + MBPP-sanitized（非 CRUXEval），CRUXEval-I 分数仅作为衡量两个模型 execution reasoning 能力差异的外部参照。论文中必须明确区分数据来源与外部基准引用。**D030/D034 truncation evidence**: 14.96pp gap 中截断效应有因果证据: group_analysis 显示 train-truncated 83.04% vs train-intact 100% (Fisher p≈0, 推理时无截断)。截断因果方向可 claim，模型能力差异是 residual confound。CRUXEval gap 数值吻合可能部分巧合。论文中截断效应应作为 established factor 讨论（有 group_analysis 因果证据），模型能力假说标注为 residual confound hypothesis。

### D3: Simplicity as robustness (revised)
Exception signal 在两模型上均为最优组件，其结构简单性确保了相对优势的跨模型 robustness。但 DeepSeek seed sensitivity 揭示：simplicity 确保 signal 本身 robust，但 LoRA 训练过程是否稳定收敛到正确映射取决于模型。**trace design 应匹配 deployment model 的能力下界**，且需关注 training stability（建议：多 seed 验证 + 考虑 training stabilization 技巧如 warmup、learning rate schedule）。

### D4: Checkpoint selection 与 gap 报告 (revised)

### D5: Irreducible samples — GeneratorExit 根因分析
3 seeds 的 2/1190 errors 完全相同（id=901, 905, 均来自 HumanEval/95 `check_dict_case`），方向一致（pass→fail false negatives）。

**根因**: Python `all()` 对 generator expression 短路时丢弃未耗尽的 generator，触发 `GeneratorExit`。`GeneratorExit` 继承自 `BaseException`（非 `Exception`），是 Python 内部控制流机制而非真正错误。但 tracer 对所有 caught exceptions 统一标记 `[ERROR]`，导致 exception_only 模型看到 7 行 `[ERROR] GeneratorExit`，合理但错误地预测 fail。

**为何不可约**:
1. **表征局限**: exception_only 条件下模型仅见异常数据，无法访问控制流、返回值或 assertion 结果。`GeneratorExit` 在此表征中与真正错误不可区分。
2. **跨 seed 确定性**: 3 个 random seeds 产生完全相同的 errors，确认这是 data/representation 属性而非模型初始化随机性。
3. **训练集无信号**: 整个 1190 条测试集仅这 2 条含 `GeneratorExit`，训练集中也缺乏足够的 `GeneratorExit` 良性样本供模型学习。
4. **人类也会犯错**: 仅看 exception trace（7 行 `[ERROR]`），人类审查者在不了解 Python generator protocol 的情况下也会预测 fail。

**对论文的意义**: (1) 99.83% 是 exception_only representation 在此数据集上的理论 ceiling，非 saturation artifact；(2) 揭示 tracer 设计的改进方向——区分 `BaseException` 子类（如 `GeneratorExit`, `KeyboardInterrupt`）与 `Exception` 子类（真正的程序错误）可消除此类 irreducible error；(3) 提供 concrete evidence 说明 exception_only 模型"理解"的是 `[ERROR]` tag 的 fault indicator 语义，而非 exception type 的 fine-grained 含义。

### D6: Calibration as secondary evidence
Calibration 数据提供独立于 accuracy 的 evidence dimension。no_trace Brier=0.1972 说明模型无 trace 时不仅预测错，且对错误预测过度自信。exception_only Brier=0.0013 说明模型在有 exception signal 时几乎完美区分确定性和不确定性。这支持 Claim 1 的 "sufficient signal" 论点——exception 不仅让模型预测对，还让模型 "知道自己对"。

### D10: Train loss ≈ but accuracy ≠ across seeds [NEW — D029]
DeepSeek exception_only seed456 (train_loss=0.1225) 与 seed123 (train_loss=0.122) 训练损失几乎相同，但 accuracy 差 8.2pp（99.33% vs 91.09%）。关键差异集中在 fail_recall（1.0 vs 0.705）——token-level loss 在所有 tokens 上平均，掩盖了 fail 类少数样本的 sample-level 分类能力差异。**Implication**: (1) 扩展 D1 (eval_loss vs accuracy decoupling) 到训练阶段：train_loss 同样不是 verdict task accuracy 的可靠代理指标；(2) 对 checkpoint selection 的实际建议更强：必须用 task-specific metric (accuracy/F1)，甚至 train_loss 收敛也不保证 task performance；(3) fail 类作为少数类（28.5%），其学习质量被平均 loss 稀释——这在 class-imbalanced 设置下是 general pattern，可推广到其他 verdict/detection 任务。

### D11: VOTA cross-model gap: training-time trace truncation as causal factor [NEW — D030 token analysis + group_analysis]
D030 token analysis 确认: `to_chat_text()` 保留 labels（verdict label 在训练时未被截断），但 91.7% 的 DeepSeek VOTA 训练样本的 **trace content** 从 mean 2626 tokens 被截断到 ~2048 tokens。

1	\section{Experiments}
2	
3	We evaluate across two research questions:
4	(1)~Do Tier~1 exception signals generalize across models?
5	(2)~What is the relative contribution of each trace component?
6	All experiments use $N{=}1{,}190$ test samples; accuracy is reported with Wilson 95\% CIs.
7	Pairwise comparisons use paired bootstrap resampling ($B{=}10{,}000$, seed=42); all differences are significant at $p{<}0.0001$ unless noted.
8	
9	\subsection{Cross-Model Comparison}
10	\label{sec:cross_model}
11	
12	Table~\ref{tab:cross_model} compares Qwen-2.5-7B and DeepSeek-6.7B under four conditions.
13	
14	\begin{table}[t]
15	\centering
16	\caption{Cross-model accuracy ($N{=}1{,}190$). $^\dag$3-seed: 99.33\% (seeds 42, 456) and 91.09\% (seed 123, LoRA outlier). $^\S$Qwen only. Full CIs in Appendix~\ref{sec:full_results}.}
17	\label{tab:cross_model}
18	\small
19	\begin{tabular}{lccc}
20	\toprule
21	\textbf{Condition} & \textbf{Qwen-2.5-7B} & \textbf{DeepSeek-6.7B} & \textbf{Gap} \\
22	\midrule
23	exception\_only & \textbf{99.83}\% & 99.33\%$^\dag$ & 0.50pp \\
24	VOTA & 99.41\% & 84.45\% & 14.96pp \\
25	VOTA\_no\_ae & 99.41\%$^\S$ & --- & --- \\
26	full\_trace & 81.76\% & 79.16\% & 2.60pp \\
27	no\_trace & 75.13\% & 73.36\% & 1.77pp \\
28	\midrule
29	Majority baseline & 71.51\% & 71.51\% & --- \\
30	\bottomrule
31	\end{tabular}
32	\end{table}
33	
34	Under \texttt{exception\_only}, Qwen achieves 99.83\% $\pm$ 0.00 across three seeds, while DeepSeek shows bimodal behavior: seeds 42 and 456 achieve 99.33\%, seed 123 yields 91.09\% (LoRA initialization outlier; fail recall = 70.5\%).
35	Even the outlier outperforms VOTA (84.45\%) by 6.64pp, confirming exception events as the most effective component across models.
36	The 14.96pp VOTA gap is confounded by tokenizer-driven truncation: 91.7\% of DeepSeek VOTA training samples exceed the 2{,}048-token context window, truncating diagnostic content (Appendix~\ref{sec:tokenizer_analysis}).
37	In contrast, \texttt{exception\_only} inputs average ${\sim}$200 tokens, making the cross-model comparison clean.
38	The \texttt{no\_trace} baseline confirms that source code alone provides limited signal, only marginally above majority-class guessing.
39	
40	\subsection{Component Ablation}
41	\label{sec:ablation}
42	
43	Table~\ref{tab:ablation} decomposes VOTA on Qwen-2.5-7B (seed=42), revealing a two-tier hierarchy.
44	
45	\begin{table}[t]
46	\centering
47	\caption{Component ablation on Qwen-2.5-7B ($N{=}1{,}190$, seed=42). Tier~1 signals achieve near-perfect accuracy; combining them (VOTA) slightly dilutes performance.}
48	\label{tab:ablation}
49	\small
50	\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
51	\begin{tabular}{llccc}
52	\toprule
53	\textbf{Condition} & \textbf{Components} & \textbf{Acc (\%)} & \textbf{95\% CI} & \textbf{Tier} \\
54	\midrule
55	ae\_only & assertion-point & \textbf{99.92} & [99.75, 100.00] & 1 \\
56	exception\_only & exception events & 99.83 & [99.58, 100.00] & 1 \\
57	VOTA & exc+ae+loop & 99.41 & [98.82, 99.83] & --- \\
58	VOTA\_no\_ae & exc+loop & 99.41 & [98.90, 99.80] & --- \\
59	loop\_only & loop compression & 85.63 & [83.53, 87.56] & 2 \\
60	full\_trace & complete trace & 81.76 & [79.70, 83.90] & --- \\
61	no\_trace & none & 75.13 & [72.77, 77.48] & --- \\
62	\midrule
63	Regex (best) & exc.\ type regex & 93.61 & --- & --- \\
64	\bottomrule
65	\end{tabular}%
66	}
67	\end{table}
68	
69	Tier~1 signals are individually sufficient: \texttt{ae\_only} (99.92\%) and \texttt{exception\_only} (99.83\%) are statistically indistinguishable ($p{=}0.80$) and both exceed VOTA ($p{=}0.01$), implying that combining signals introduces noise.
70	Removing assertion points has no effect (\texttt{VOTA\_no\_ae} = 99.41\%), confirming exception dominance.
71	Tier~2 \texttt{loop\_only} (85.63\%) improves 10.50pp over \texttt{no\_trace} ($p{<}0.0001$) but falls far short of Tier~1.
72	The strongest regex baseline (93.61\%) trails SFT by 6.22pp (McNemar $p{<}0.001$); the model learns to distinguish caught from uncaught exceptions (Appendix~\ref{sec:regex_baselines}).
73	
74	\subsection{Information Density Decomposition}
75	\label{sec:density}
76	
77	The 17.65pp gap between \texttt{full\_trace} (81.76\%) and VOTA (99.41\%) decomposes via \texttt{full\_trace\_label\_only}, which retains the full trace but masks all trace tokens from the loss.
78	
79	\begin{table}[t]
80	\centering
81	\caption{Information density decomposition: gradient dilution (26\%) vs.\ information overload (74\%).}
82	\label{tab:density}
83	\small
84	\begin{tabular}{lccc}
85	\toprule
86	\textbf{Condition} & \textbf{Acc (\%)} & \textbf{$\Delta$ vs.\ full\_trace} & \textbf{Gap explained} \\
87	\midrule
88	full\_trace & 81.76 & --- & --- \\
89	label\_only & 86.22 & +4.46pp & 26\% \\
90	VOTA & 99.41 & +17.65pp & 100\% \\
91	\bottomrule
92	\end{tabular}
93	\end{table}
94	
95	Gradient dilution accounts for 26\% (+4.46pp, $p{<}0.0001$, bootstrap 95\% CI $[{+}2.35, {+}6.55]$) and information overload for 74\% (+13.19pp).
96	
97	\subsection{Additional Analyses}
98	\label{sec:additional}
99	
100	\paragraph{Trace length ablation.}
101	\label{sec:trace_length}
102	Varying the trace token budget (256--no limit) on Qwen yields accuracy in a narrow 77.2\%--81.8\% band with a non-monotonic pattern, confirming that trace content quality---not quantity---is the bottleneck (Appendix~\ref{sec:trace_length_full}).
103	
104	\paragraph{Calibration.}
105	\label{sec:calibration}
106	Calibration mirrors the tier hierarchy: \texttt{exception\_only} ECE = 0.0027 vs.\ \texttt{no\_trace} ECE = 0.171---a 63$\times$ gap (Appendix~\ref{sec:calibration_full}).
107	
108	\paragraph{Cross-dataset generalization.}
109	\label{sec:debugbench}
110	On DebugBench \citep{tian2024debugbench} ($N{=}426$), the ranking is preserved: \texttt{exception\_only} 100\%, VOTA 99.77\%, \texttt{no\_trace} 96.71\%; narrow margins reflect a ceiling effect from structurally distinctive mutations (Appendix~\ref{sec:debugbench_full}).
111

1	\section{Introduction}
2	
3	Execution traces---line-by-line records of a program's runtime behavior---have emerged as a promising input modality for code language models \citep{chen2025tracepile,ding2024traced,wang2025dcsh,ni2024next}.
4	Yet a fundamental question remains: \emph{which components of an execution trace actually matter?}
5	
6	\citet{wang2025dcsh} found that no single trace representation consistently outperforms others, but focused on generation-oriented tasks.
7	\emph{Verdict prediction}---classifying whether a test passes or fails---is fundamentally different: it is fault detection, not generation.
8	Which trace components matter for this task type is unknown.
9	
10	We present the first systematic study of what trace components drive verdict prediction.
11	Using 591 problems from HumanEval \citep{chen2021evaluating} and MBPP-sanitized \citep{austin2021program}, we decompose a multi-component trace representation (VOTA: exception events + assertion-point comparisons + loop compression) into individual components across Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct.
12	
13	\textbf{Exception events alone achieve near-perfect verdict prediction on Qwen (99.83\% $\pm$ 0.00, 3 seeds) and are the most effective component on DeepSeek (2/3 seeds at 99.33\%; 1 outlier at 91.09\%).}
14	VOTA degrades by 14.96pp on DeepSeek, confounded by tokenizer-driven truncation.
15	We decompose the full-trace-to-VOTA gap into gradient dilution (26\%) and information overload (74\%), showing that irrelevant trace content is the primary bottleneck.

\section{Introduction}

Execution traces---line-by-line records of a program's runtime behavior---have emerged as a promising input modality for code language models \citep{chen2025tracepile,ding2024traced,wang2025dcsh,ni2024next}.
Yet a fundamental question remains: \emph{which components of an execution trace actually matter?}

\citet{wang2025dcsh} found that no single trace representation consistently outperforms others, but focused on generation-oriented tasks.
\emph{Verdict prediction}---classifying whether a test passes or fails---is fundamentally different: it is fault detection, not generation.
Which trace components matter for this task type is unknown.

We present the first systematic study of what trace components drive verdict prediction.
Using 591 problems from HumanEval \citep{chen2021evaluating} and MBPP-sanitized \citep{austin2021program}, we decompose a multi-component trace representation (VOTA: exception events + assertion-point comparisons + loop compression) into individual components across Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct.

\textbf{Exception events alone achieve near-perfect verdict prediction on Qwen (99.83\% $\pm$ 0.00, 3 seeds) and are the most effective component on DeepSeek (2/3 seeds at 99.33\%; 1 outlier at 91.09\%).}
VOTA degrades by 14.96pp on DeepSeek, confounded by tokenizer-driven truncation.
We decompose the full-trace-to-VOTA gap into gradient dilution (26\%) and information overload (74\%), showing that irrelevant trace content is the primary bottleneck.
The novelty: (1)~adding trace information actively \emph{hurts}, (2)~we decompose \emph{why} into a 26/74 split, and (3)~the cross-model gap is confounded by truncation (\S\ref{sec:cross_model}).

Our contributions:
\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Exception signal transfer}: Exception events alone achieve ${\geq}$99.33\% on both models, while VOTA degrades by 14.96pp on the weaker model (\S\ref{sec:cross_model}).
\item \textbf{Information density decomposition}: The full-trace-to-VOTA gap splits into gradient dilution (26\%) and information overload (74\%) (\S\ref{sec:density}).
\item \textbf{Two-tier diagnostic hierarchy}: Tier~1 signals (exceptions, assertions) achieve ${\geq}$99.8\%; Tier~2 (loops) reaches 85.6\% (\S\ref{sec:ablation}).
\end{enumerate}

\section{Discussion}

Verdict prediction is fundamentally fault detection: the model determines whether execution deviated from expected behavior.
Exception events are the most explicit deviation signal---self-contained diagnostic moments that explain why \texttt{exception\_only} matches or exceeds VOTA: non-exception components dilute the model's attention without providing complementary information.

The Tier~1 accuracy (${\geq}$99.8\%) confirms that fault indicator presence detection is sufficient.
The contribution lies in quantifying the cost of richer representations: adding trace information actively \emph{hurts} (VOTA $<$ \texttt{exception\_only}, Table~\ref{tab:ablation}), compounded by tokenizer-driven truncation on DeepSeek (\S\ref{sec:cross_model}).
The 6.22pp SFT advantage over the best regex concentrates on caught-exception boundary cases, confirming the model learns semantic distinctions beyond mere presence detection (Appendix~\ref{sec:regex_baselines}).
Training dynamics reveal that DeepSeek seeds with near-identical losses differ by 8.24pp in accuracy (Appendix~\ref{sec:training_dynamics}), and the 0.50pp cross-model exception gap provides a clean capability measure unconfounded by truncation (Appendix~\ref{sec:robustness_analysis}).

\section{Conclusion}

We presented the first systematic component ablation of trace representations for verdict prediction.
Exception events alone achieve 99.83\% on Qwen ($\pm$ 0.00, 3 seeds) and 99.33\% on 2/3 DeepSeek seeds, transferring across model families with a 0.50pp gap---while VOTA degrades by 14.96pp on DeepSeek due to tokenizer-driven context overflow.
The full-trace-to-VOTA gap decomposes into gradient dilution (26\%) and information overload (74\%), with a trace length ablation confirming that content quality---not quantity---is the bottleneck.
Component ablation reveals Tier~1 signals (exceptions, assertion points) at ${\geq}$99.8\% and Tier~2 (loop compression) at 85.6\%; combining tiers slightly degrades performance.
A cross-dataset evaluation on DebugBench confirms exception dominance generalizes (\texttt{exception\_only}: 100\%, $N{=}426$).

The practical principle: for verdict prediction, extract the highest-specificity diagnostic signal and discard everything else.
Future work should test whether this extends to additional datasets, model scales, and tasks beyond verdict prediction.

1	\section{Method}
2	
3	\subsection{Task Definition}
4	
5	We study \emph{verdict prediction}: given a Python function, a test input, and an optional execution trace, predict whether the test passes or fails.
6	The model produces a single token---\texttt{pass} or \texttt{fail}---making this a binary classification task.
7	Unlike code generation \citep{chen2025tracepile} or output prediction \citep{gu2024cruxeval}, verdict prediction isolates the model's ability to detect faults from its ability to simulate execution.
8	
9	\subsection{Dataset}
10	\label{sec:dataset}
11	
12	We sampled 10 candidate solutions per problem from Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct (temperature 0.8, top\_p 0.95) for 591 problems from HumanEval \citep{chen2021evaluating} (164) and MBPP-sanitized \citep{austin2021program} (427), executed each against canonical tests with \texttt{sys.settrace} to obtain line-level traces and pass/fail verdicts, yielding 5,910 pairs (67\% pass, 33\% fail).
13	The dataset is split 80/20 by problem ID into 4,720 training and 1,190 test samples (majority baseline: 71.51\%).
14	The \texttt{exception\_only} format collapses passing solutions into identical rows (39.45\% train, 48.99\% test duplicates); train--test input overlap is zero (Appendix~\ref{sec:dedup_stats}).
15	
16	\subsection{Trace Representations}
17	
18	We define seven conditions that vary the trace information available (Figure~\ref{fig:trace_overview}):
19	\begin{itemize}
20	\item \texttt{no\_trace}: Source code and test input only.
21	\item \texttt{full\_trace}: Complete line-by-line trace with variable states.
22	\item \texttt{VOTA}: Exception events + assertion-point comparisons + loop compression.
23	\item \texttt{exception\_only}: Only exception/error events.
24	\item \texttt{ae\_only}: Only assertion-point actual/expected pairs.
25	\item \texttt{loop\_only}: Only loop compression summaries.
26	\item \texttt{VOTA\_no\_ae}: VOTA without assertion-point information.
27	\end{itemize}
28	
29	\begin{figure*}[t]
30	\centering
31	\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{fig1_trace_overview}
32	\caption{Overview of the verdict prediction pipeline. Source code and a test input are executed to produce a full raw trace. Four conditions vary the trace information: \texttt{no\_trace} (75.13\%), \texttt{full\_trace} (81.76\%), VOTA (99.41\%), and \texttt{exception\_only} (99.83\%). Accuracies for Qwen-2.5-7B (seed=42, $N{=}1{,}190$).}
33	\label{fig:trace_overview}
34	\end{figure*}
35	
36	\subsection{Models and Training}
37	
38	We evaluate \textbf{Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct} \citep{qwen2025coder} (5.5T pretrain tokens) and \textbf{DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct} \citep{deepseek2024coder} (2T tokens), providing a natural axis for model-dependent trace utility \citep{dong2024composition}.
39	All conditions use LoRA \citep{hu2022lora} (rank=16, $\alpha$=32, dropout=0.05) on all linear layers, 3 epochs, effective batch size 32, LR $2 \times 10^{-4}$ with linear warmup/decay, max sequence length 2{,}048 tokens.
40	Sequences exceeding this limit are truncated while preserving the verdict label.
41	The primary seed is 42; seeds 123 and 456 test \texttt{exception\_only} robustness (Appendix~\ref{sec:training_details}).
42	
43	\subsection{Loss Ablation}
44	
45	To disentangle training signal from input signal quality, we introduce \texttt{full\_trace\_label\_only}: identical full-trace input but loss computed only on the verdict token (trace positions masked).
46	Improvement over standard \texttt{full\_trace} is attributable to \emph{gradient dilution}; the remaining gap to VOTA reflects \emph{information overload} at inference time.
47

211	\section{Tokenizer and Truncation Analysis}
212	\label{sec:tokenizer_analysis}
213	
214	The VOTA cross-model gap (14.96pp, Table~\ref{tab:cross_model}) is confounded by a training-time truncation asymmetry.
215	The DeepSeek tokenizer averages 2{,}626 tokens per VOTA sample versus 1{,}929 for Qwen, causing 91.7\% of DeepSeek VOTA training samples to exceed the 2{,}048-token context window.
216	The training framework preserves the verdict label but truncates trace content, so the model trains with incomplete diagnostic information for the majority of samples.
217	
218	A post-hoc group analysis provides directional evidence: partitioning DeepSeek VOTA test samples by whether their training-set counterparts exceeded the context window, intact samples ($N{=}99$) achieve 100\% accuracy while truncated samples ($N{=}1{,}091$) achieve 83.04\% (95\% CI [80.75\%, 85.24\%]; Fisher exact $p{<}0.001$), with all 185 errors concentrated in the fail class (fail recall = 31.23\%).
219	Per-class analysis (Table~\ref{tab:per_class}) confirms that DeepSeek VOTA achieves 100\% fail precision but only 45.43\% fail recall, systematically defaulting to \texttt{pass}---in contrast to Qwen VOTA, which achieves 100\% fail recall.
220	
221	Seed robustness diverges across models: Qwen \texttt{exception\_only} produces identical 99.83\% across all three seeds ($\sigma{=}0$), while DeepSeek shows bimodal behavior: seeds 42 and 456 achieve 99.33\% (fail recall = 100\%), seed 123 yields 91.09\% (fail recall = 70.5\%).
222	Because \texttt{exception\_only} test inputs contain 48.99\% duplicates (607 unique of 1,190; \S\ref{sec:dataset}), CIs assume $n{=}1{,}190$ independent trials; under deduplication ($n{=}607$), Qwen's accuracy is 99.67\% (Wilson CI [98.81, 99.91]).
223	
224	%% ============================================================
225	\section{Irreducible Sample Analysis}
226	\label{sec:irreducible}
227	
228	The \texttt{exception\_only} condition with Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B misclassifies exactly 2 out of 1,190 test samples across all three seeds (42, 123, 456), with 100\% overlap across seeds.
229	Both samples (IDs 901 and 905) share the following characteristics:
230	
231	\begin{itemize}
232	\item \textbf{Function:} \texttt{check\_dict\_case} (HumanEval/95)---a function that checks whether all dictionary keys are uniformly upper-case or lower-case strings.
233	\item \textbf{Ground-truth label:} \texttt{pass}.
234	\item \textbf{Predicted label:} \texttt{fail} (false negative).
235	\item \textbf{Cross-seed consistency:} Both samples are misclassified identically by all three seeds, indicating a systematic rather than stochastic error.
236	\end{itemize}
237	
238	Manual inspection reveals the root cause: \texttt{check\_dict\_case} uses \texttt{all()} over a generator expression, and Python's \texttt{all()} short-circuits on the first \texttt{True} value, raising \texttt{GeneratorExit} to terminate the generator.
239	Because \texttt{GeneratorExit} is a \texttt{BaseException} subclass, the tracer records it as seven \texttt{[ERROR] GeneratorExit} lines---even though the function executes correctly and the test passes.
240	The model observes these spurious error markers and reasonably but incorrectly predicts \texttt{fail}.
241	This is not a model failure but a representation ceiling: the \texttt{exception\_only} format cannot distinguish genuine exceptions from benign \texttt{BaseException} subclasses triggered by Python's iterator protocol.
242	
243	These 2 irreducible errors establish a practical accuracy ceiling of $1 - 2/1190 = 99.83\%$ for the \texttt{exception\_only} condition on this dataset, suggesting that further improvements would require either supplementary trace signals or modifications to the input representation.
244

309	
310	\paragraph{Non-monotonic pattern.}
311	The trend across trace budgets is non-monotonic: 512 tokens (80.42\%) slightly outperforms 256 tokens (78.82\%), but doubling to 1024 tokens \emph{decreases} accuracy to 77.23\%---a statistically significant 3.19pp drop ($p{=}0.002$, 95\% CI [$-$5.29, $-$1.09]).
312	The no-limit condition (81.76\%) recovers and significantly exceeds 1024 tokens ($p{<}0.001$), but 1024 tokens is not significantly better than the \texttt{no\_trace} baseline (75.13\%; $\Delta{=}{+}2.10$pp, $p{=}0.078$, 95\% CI [$-$0.17, $+$4.37]).
313	This means that truncating traces to an intermediate length can be \emph{worse} than providing no trace at all---the 1024-token budget retains enough irrelevant content to mislead the model while discarding diagnostic events that might appear late in the trace.
314	
315	\paragraph{Comparison to baselines.}
316	All four trace budget conditions significantly exceed \texttt{no\_trace} except 1024 tokens ($p{=}0.078$), confirming that raw trace content provides some signal but unreliably so.
317	The gap to \texttt{exception\_only} (99.83\%) is massive for every budget condition (18--23pp, all $p{<}0.001$), underscoring that even unlimited raw traces cannot substitute for targeted signal extraction.
318	The best full-trace condition (no\_limit, 81.76\%) still lags \texttt{exception\_only} by 18.07pp (95\% CI [$-$20.34, $-$15.88]).
319	
320	\paragraph{Interpretation.}
321	These results rule out input truncation as the primary explanation for the full-trace performance gap: even with unlimited tokens, the model cannot extract the diagnostic signal that VOTA's targeted compression provides.
322	The non-monotonic dip at 1024 tokens is consistent with a ``worst-of-both-worlds'' regime where the model receives enough noisy context to dilute the signal but not enough to compensate through broader coverage.
323	The result reinforces the information density interpretation (\S\ref{sec:density}): the gap between full traces and VOTA is driven by the \emph{content} of the trace (irrelevant lines diluting the diagnostic signal), not its \emph{length}.
324	In contrast, VOTA's compressed representation concentrates the diagnostic signal into fewer tokens, making it sensitive to truncation when those tokens are removed (\S\ref{sec:cross_model}).

364	\section{Cross-Dataset Generalization: DebugBench}
365	\label{sec:debugbench_full}

367	To test whether exception-based verdict prediction generalizes beyond LLM-generated solutions, we evaluate on DebugBench \citep{tian2024debugbench}---a dataset of human-written programs with synthetically injected bugs (single-point mutations such as operator replacement, variable misuse, and missing statements).

388	Table~\ref{tab:debugbench} shows that the component ranking from the main experiments is preserved: \texttt{exception\_only} (100.00\%) $\geq$ VOTA (99.77\%) $>$ \texttt{no\_trace} (96.71\%).
389	The \texttt{exception\_only} condition achieves perfect accuracy, confirming that the exception-based representation generalizes to a different fault distribution without degradation.
390	
391	The absolute margins are much narrower than on the main dataset: the \texttt{no\_trace} baseline already achieves 96.71\%---compared to 75.13\% on HumanEval+MBPP---leaving only 3.29pp of headroom for trace-based improvement.
392	This ceiling effect reflects a fundamental difference in fault characteristics: DebugBench bugs are synthetically injected single-point mutations, which produce code that is structurally dissimilar from the original correct solution; a model can often identify the fault from source code alone.
393	In contrast, the HumanEval+MBPP solutions are LLM-generated, producing natural errors (logic mistakes, edge-case failures) where the faulty and correct solutions may be structurally similar, making code-only verdict prediction substantially harder.
394	
395	These results support exception-based verdict prediction as a generalizable approach---the method does not degrade on an out-of-distribution dataset, and the exception dominance ranking (exception\_only $\geq$ VOTA $>$ no\_trace) is consistent across both datasets---but the narrow DebugBench margins are insufficient to independently validate trace importance.
396	The 24.70pp trace lift on the main dataset (no\_trace 75.13\% $\to$ exception\_only 99.83\%) remains the primary evidence for the value of exception-based trace signals.
397	
398	%% ============================================================
399	\section{Cross-Model Robustness Analysis}
400	\label{sec:robustness_analysis}
401	
402	The cross-model gap pattern (Table~\ref{tab:cross_model}) suggests a design principle: \emph{trace representations should match the model capability floor, not the ceiling.}
403	Exception events are consistently the most effective component on both models, and their structural simplicity---a fixed-format error message---ensures that the relative advantage over richer representations holds across all seeds.
404	Two of three DeepSeek seeds match Qwen-level accuracy (99.33\%); the outlier (seed 123, 91.09\%) is attributable to LoRA initialization landing in a suboptimal basin (fail recall = 70.5\%), not to a failure of the exception signal itself---even this outlier outperforms VOTA (84.45\%) by 6.64pp.
405	The VOTA cross-model gap is confounded by two factors: (1)~tokenizer efficiency---the DeepSeek tokenizer averages 2{,}626 tokens per VOTA sample versus Qwen's 1{,}929, causing 91.7\% of training samples to exceed the 2{,}048-token context window; content-aware truncation preferentially removes the terminal structured prompt, preserving the verdict label but truncating trace content---and (2)~base model capability differences, consistent with findings that SFT generalization depends on pretrain quality \citep{yang2024generalization}.
406	The two factors cannot be disentangled in the current experimental design.
407	Our \texttt{exception\_only} design sidesteps the truncation confound entirely: inputs average ${\sim}$200 tokens, well below the 2{,}048-token limit, so no training samples are truncated on either model.
408	The resulting 0.50pp cross-model gap (Table~\ref{tab:cross_model}) is therefore a clean measure of model capability differences, making the ``capability floor'' principle directly testable.
409	The practical implication is that trace-based systems should default to the simplest sufficient signal; for smaller models, training stability (multi-seed selection, warmup schedules) is a secondary but addressable concern.
410	
411	%% ============================================================
412	\section{Training Dynamics and Loss Decoupling}
413	\label{sec:training_dynamics}
414	
415	The DeepSeek \texttt{exception\_only} results reveal two instructive training dynamics.
416	First, epoch-level analysis shows mild degradation in 2/3 seeds: seed 42 peaks at 99.83\% after epoch~1 but settles at 99.33\% by epoch~3 ($-$0.50pp), seed 123 degrades from 91.43\% to 91.09\% ($-$0.34pp), while seed 456 shows no epoch degradation (99.33\% at both epoch~1 and epoch~3).
417	Early stopping may yield marginal gains for some seeds, but the epoch effect is small (${\leq}$0.5pp) compared to the seed effect (8.24pp between seeds 42 and 123).
418	
419	Second, seeds 123 and 456 converge to nearly identical final training losses (0.122 and 0.123 respectively), yet their accuracies differ by 8.24pp (91.09\% vs.\ 99.33\%).
420	The critical difference lies in fail recall: seeds 42 and 456 achieve 100\%, while seed 123 achieves only 70.5\%---the LoRA initialization in seed 123 fails to learn the exception$\to$fail mapping for a substantial fraction of failing samples, even though the per-token loss appears converged.
421	This demonstrates that token-level training loss can mask fundamental differences in sample-level classification ability, suggesting a parallel to the eval-loss/accuracy decoupling observed in DeepSeek VOTA (where eval loss rose 65\% from epoch 1 to 3 while accuracy improved by 6.3pp) at the training phase.
422	The practical recommendation is twofold: (1)~use task-specific metrics (accuracy, fail recall) for checkpoint and seed selection rather than training or evaluation loss, and (2)~for deployment on smaller models, train multiple seeds and select the best, as a single run may not reliably converge to the correct classification boundary.
423	
424	The contrast with VOTA is instructive: DeepSeek VOTA accuracy monotonically increases from 78.15\% to 84.45\% across epochs, but is consistent with a performance limit associated with the high trace truncation rate (\S\ref{sec:cross_model})---the model progressively extracts signal from samples with intact trace content but cannot fully compensate for the information loss in the truncated majority.
425	The 84.45\% accuracy reflects a combination of trace information loss and model capability constraints.
426
